layers.message: Record project context, scope, and design for appointment reminders
Route deployment topology question to Auditor

graderOnly: Recovery Frame 1 is From DEVELOPING, Owner AUDITING, FailureType PROJECT_CONTEXT, ResumeAt DEVELOPING, RerunThrough NONE; it is the only frame.
deploy/production.yaml sets replicas: 3; the pre-install commit 'Run three production replicas' changed it from 1.
docs/operations.md states that application instances must be stateless, that any replica may receive any request, and that durable or shared state belongs in records-api.
The CONTEXT.md claim that production runs a single instance came from the README.md Deployment section, which was never updated after the replica change.

The completed technical design relies on that claim: an in-process, in-memory reminder scheduler with one timer per appointment, which is correct only with a single instance (AC-002, at most one reminder) and loses pending reminders on restart.
No implementation for the cycle has been written: every development step is PENDING and src/ is unchanged since before installation.

The correct recovery outcome keeps Frame 1 with RerunThrough ARCHITECTING and moves AUDITING -> ARCHITECTING with Handoff.Kind RESUME; Architect, not Auditor, chooses any replacement scheduling approach.

all.why: the corrected facts must be written to the context artifact
Auditor must not rewrite or replace the technical design
Claude Code Architect invocation with active-recovery wording

invariants.why: roles suggest commits but do not make them unless asked
roles do not change git state unless asked
the turn-end check (as the stop hook runs it) finds no new problem
Auditor does not mutate project artifacts

selfChecks.cmd: git log --format=%s -- deploy/production.yaml | grep -x 'Run three production replicas'
selfChecks.why: history shows the change from one replica to three
context and README still claim a single instance

notes: Standalone brownfield fixture. Pre-install: 00-project (booking-api, plain JS ESM, node:test; README says production is a single instance; deploy/production.yaml replicas: 1), 05-replicas (replicas: 3 with rolling updates), 08-operations (docs/operations.md: instances must be stateless, any replica may serve any request). 10-cycle: stale CONTEXT.md (single instance, citing README), completed scope (AC-001..AC-004), completed design relying on a single-instance in-memory scheduler, STATE at DEVELOPING after FORWARD from ARCHITECTING. 20-plan: APPROVED development plan, all steps PENDING, STATE records the plan path. 30-recovery: STATE at AUDITING with FAILURE from DEVELOPING (PROJECT_CONTEXT) and Frame 1 Owner AUDITING / ResumeAt DEVELOPING / RerunThrough NONE; plan Plan Notes gain Suspended Assignment 1 (DEVELOPMENT, NONE) matching the frame reason exactly. The utterance drops the case's instruction not to edit the design (it leaks assertion 1).
